tests.title: Private Hire Driver Licence Knowledge — Mock Test 1

questions.question: How long is a standard TfL private hire driver's licence usually valid for?
questions.explanation: TfL grants standard PHV driver licences for a three-year period subject to checks.

questions.question: Before working as a London PHV driver, you must be licensed by:
questions.explanation: Transport for London is the licensing authority for taxi and private hire in the capital.

questions.question: Private hire bookings in London must always be:
questions.explanation: Only licensed black cabs may be hailed or use ranks; PHVs must be pre-booked via a licensed operator.

questions.question: Which document must be displayed inside a licensed private hire vehicle?
options: TfL driver and vehicle ID disc
questions.explanation: Both the driver and vehicle identifiers issued by TfL must be displayed.

questions.question: The minimum age to apply for a TfL PHV driver's licence is:
questions.explanation: Applicants must usually be at least 21 and have held a full DVLA licence for three years.

questions.question: If your driving licence is endorsed during your PHV licence period, you must:
options: Notify TfL within the required period
questions.explanation: Drivers must notify TfL of relevant changes including endorsements.

questions.question: Operating as a PHV driver without a valid licence is:
questions.explanation: Driving an unlicensed PHV is a criminal offence under the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.

questions.question: PHV drivers must hold what type of insurance?
questions.explanation: Hire and reward cover is required for any vehicle carrying paying passengers.
